messages:
alex: Quick sync — new model candidate 'cobalt-9b-alpha' landed in the registry. Want to run the gate checklist, produce a catalog entry, and coordinate an announcement/canary. Proposing we prioritize quant experiments + targeted quality checks. Thoughts?

maya: I'll own evals and quant experiments. Which workloads should I prioritize? summarization, chat, codegen?

alex: Prioritize: 1) chat convo (latency + hallucination spot checks), 2) summarization (ROUGE / semantic similarity), 3) instruction-following correctness, 4) code generation (pass@1 / compile rate). Also quick embedding alignment sanity. We'll compare against onyx-7b and lumen-13b baselines.

ryan: I'll draft the catalog entry and model card. Can you (maya) paste perf numbers and the model config when available? Need model_size, tokenizer, license, recommended quant flags.

maya: Plan for quant runs today: FP16 baseline on Dedicated, 8-bit (bnb) and 4-bit (nf4) variants. Kernel variants: fused and aten fallbacks. Run command (rough): `python eval/run_eval.py --model cobalt-9b-alpha --tasks chat,summarize,code --quant 4bit,8bit,fp16 --batch 8`

leila: Also add a prod-slo regression set: ~50 prompts sampled from live traffic (anonymized). If cobalt regresses >2% ROUGE or >3% in code pass@1 vs baseline, block canary.

tom: Ops: Canary plan proposal — stages 0% -> 5% for 2h -> 20% for 6h -> 100%. Must have rollback flag and auto-fallback to onyx-7b if latency_p95 > 1.2x or error_rate > 0.5%. Need runbook + alerting thresholds.

alex: Add doc tasks: catalog entry with usage examples, recommended quant profile, known failure modes, and migration notes. Ryan, put the draft at `/docs/models/cobalt-9b-alpha.md` and ping #docs-review.

ryan: Draft created (WIP): https://redwood.internal/docs/cobalt-9b-alpha — adding config snippet now: 
``
model: cobalt-9b-alpha
params: 9000000000
tokenizer: t5-bpe
license: apache-2.0
recommended_quant: nf4
``
Please confirm tokenizer + license.

maya: Confirm tokenizer is t5-bpe. License looks permissive but I'll double-check legal. Early FP16 evals on our dedicated instance: chat p95 latency ~120ms, ROUGE-L avg 0.62 (onyx-7b = 0.60), code pass@1 0.48 (onyx-7b = 0.52) — code looks regressed, re-running with larger beam and few-shot.

leila: Code regression is concerning. Add a focused code eval slice (unit-test-style prompts) and try few-shot priming. If regression persists, annotate catalog and run canary with reduced weight for code-serving endpoints.

tom: I'll prepare canary rollout config + runbook. Example rollout snippet for console: 
``
rollout:
  stages: [5,20,100]
  duration_hours: [2,6,12]
  fallback: onyx-7b
  metrics: [latency_p95, error_rate, rouge_l]
``
Will add alerts for quality regressions and an ops checklist.

deploy-bot: Canary job queued — id `cj_981234`. Will post when health checks start/finish.

alex: Action items summary: 
- maya: full quant matrix + prod-slo regression checks by EOD
- ryan: publish catalog draft + model card by EOD, include config snippet and usage examples
- leila: run code-focused eval and propose thresholds
- tom: canary config + runbook + alerts
We'll sync tomorrow 10:00AM if any blockers. :thumbsup:
